scheme_name: Chief Minister's Building and Other Construction Workers Housing (Rural) Scheme
other_conditions: Applicant must be a resident of Madhya Pradesh
Applicant must be a building or construction worker
Applicant must have worked at least 90 days in the preceding 12 months
Applicant must not be eligible for housing grants under Indira Awas Yojana or Chief Minister Antyodaya Awas Yojana
Family may own a maximum of three hectares of agricultural land
Family income from all sources must not exceed ₹3 lakh per annum
Applicant must have sufficient land available for house construction
Applicant must be eligible to receive land for housing from the government
Applicant must be willing to construct a house on agricultural land owned by them
Applicant must be eligible to obtain a landholder certificate in the village population
Applicant must agree to obtain a bank loan for constructing a house with a 225 sq ft plinth area and provide their own contribution in the form of labour, material, or inclusion
benefits_summary: Provides a minimum loan grant of ₹50,000 per beneficiary, with banks potentially approving an additional loan of up to ₹30,000, limited to ₹50,000 per case.
documents_required: Self‑attested copies of all mandatory documents
